title.zh: 线下网关扩容文件共享

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

请先在安装线下网关的虚拟化环境中，对需要扩容的文件共享对应的缓存盘进行扩容操作。
descriptions.en:
Before you call this operation, take note of the following information:

In the virtual environment where the on-premises gateway is installed, you must first increase the capacity of the cache disk that corresponds to the share.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw expand-gateway-file-share --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbv0000 --index-id SMBpapcn --region cn-hangzhou
